title: 第九章 赤地祈雨 鏖战旱魃第十章 古寨妖蛇 噬童罹难
content_zh:
辞翠云岭，四神循西路疾行，未及半日，周遭景致骤变。
先是草木渐疏，继而嘉木枯槁，再行数里，竟成赤地千里之象。但见田畴龟裂，纵横如蛛网，禾苗尽枯，寸草不生；黄沙漫卷，遮天蔽日，烈日悬空，酷烈如火，热风扑面，灼人肌肤。往日阡陌交通，尽成荒墟，不见炊烟，不闻犬吠，唯余满目荒芜，死气沉沉。
行至日暮，忽见道旁匍匐饥民，面黄肌瘦，衣不蔽体，或卧于枯土之上，气息奄奄；或扶老携幼，流离道旁，哭声嘶哑，惨不忍闻。枯骨弃于荒野，饿殍横于路侧，一派人间炼狱之景，令人触目惊心。
四神见此惨状，皆面露恻然，神色凝重。
宁洋北驻足，青木灵气轻探，只觉此地地气干涸，生机断绝，烈日酷烈非比寻常，绝非天然旱灾，沉声道：“此地赤地千里，民不聊生，生机尽绝，酷烈之气冲天，必是旱魃作祟，阻塞云雨，以致生灵涂炭。”
王学南掐指推演，面色愈沉，叹曰：“此旱已延三载，滴雨未降，江河断流，井泉干涸，百姓食草根树皮殆尽，流离失所，死伤无数。旱魃乃上古旱妖，所居之处，赤地千里，云雨不通，寻常灵力，难撼其威。”
张忠东怒火中烧，手握火焰灵杖，愤然道：“妖孽作祟，残害苍生，我等身负救世天命，岂能坐视不管！定要斩除此妖，降下甘霖，救万民于水火！”
陈学西眸光冷冽，扫视枯寂四野，周身白虎杀气隐隐，默然颔首，已然做好御敌之备。
正言语间，一众饥民见四神气度不凡，周身隐有灵光，知是得道高人，纷纷挣扎着爬起，匍匐于地，叩首不止，哭声悲切：“仙长救命！仙长救命啊！此地大旱三载，颗粒无收，百姓死伤无数，求仙长发慈悲，降下甘霖，救救我们！”
老者扶杖，孩童啼哭，声声泣血，叩首不止，额头渗血，惨不忍睹。
宁洋北连忙上前，扶起众人，温声正色道：“诸位乡亲莫慌，我等四人，乃西行救世之人，见此灾情，必倾力相助，斩除旱妖，疏通云雨，为百姓求来甘霖，绝不让苍生再受此苦！”
百姓闻言，喜极而泣，再度叩拜，感恩之声不绝于耳。
宁洋北当即与三人商议：“旱魃盘踞此地，阻绝云气，普通祈雨无用，需筑设祈雨法坛，我四人以四方神君神力，引动天地云气，上达天庭，下撼地脉，再合力斩杀旱魃，方能降雨济民。”
王学南颔首：“此法可行。需择高地筑坛，我等四人分守四方，以青木生机引地气，玄武厚重镇地脉，朱雀圣火通天意，白虎金锋肃妖邪，合力祭天，方可召云致雨。”
当即，四神寻得一处高岗，命百姓退至安全之地，着手筑坛。
宁洋北催动青木灵气，化枯木为石料，聚沙土为坛基，顷刻之间，一座三丈高台祈雨坛，巍然矗立。坛分四级，对应四方，坛上不设牺牲，不焚纸钱，唯置四方位灵位，暗含天地阴阳之理。
坛成，四人登坛，各守一方。
宁洋北居东，青木灵气冲天，唤醒大地残存生机；
王学南居北，玄武灵气沉凝，稳固地脉，疏通水汽；
张忠东居南，火焰灵杖指天，朱雀圣火化作霞光，上通天庭，感召云雨；

陈学西居西，白虎利刃立于坛前，肃杀之气笼罩，戒备旱魃来袭。
四人凝神聚力，双手掐诀，口中默念祈雨诀，四方神力交融，化作一道通天灵光，直冲云霄。
原本烈日高悬、万里无云的苍穹，竟渐渐风起，云层缓缓汇聚，天色由赤转暗，乌云层层叠叠，翻涌而来，隐隐有雷鸣之声，降雨之兆，已然显现。
地面百姓见此异象，皆跪地叩首，屏息以待，眼中满是期盼。
便在此时，忽闻一声尖利刺耳的狂笑，自九天之上滚滚传来，笑声酷烈干燥，所过之处，云层竟隐隐消散，热风更盛：“何方小辈，竟敢擅闯吾之地界，妄图祈雨，坏我好事！”
话音落，苍穹乌云裂开一道缝隙，一道赤红身影自云间坠落，立于半空。
此妖周身赤红如火，发丝如焰，面如枯槁，双目赤红如火，身披赤红色鳞甲，周身散发着滔天燥热之气，所过之处，空气扭曲，草木瞬间枯焦，正是上古旱魃！
旱魃立于云端，居高临下，睥睨坛上四神，厉声喝道：“吾在此修行千年，吸尽此地水汽，自成一方天地，尔等凡胎神君，也敢多管闲事，祈雨坏我道行？速速退去，饶尔等不死，否则，吾便让此地彻底化为死地，让尔等灰飞烟灭！”
宁洋北立于坛上，神色凛然，厉声斥道：“旱魃妖孽！你盘踞此地，阻绝云雨，致使赤地千里，生灵涂炭，百姓惨死，罪孽滔天，天地不容！我等奉天命救世，今日定要斩你，疏通云雨，拯救万民！”
旱魃闻言，仰天狂笑，笑声愈发尖利，周身赤光暴涨，燥热之气席卷四方，刚汇聚的乌云，竟被硬生生逼退数里：“就凭尔等？也敢口出狂言！吾乃上古旱妖，云雨见我则避，江河遇我则枯，尔等凡力，岂能撼我！”
言罢，旱魃抬手一挥，漫天赤红色旱气铺天盖地而来，所过之处，地面枯木瞬间化为飞灰，龟裂之地愈发严重，百姓惊呼连连，热风灼得众人难以睁眼。
张忠东怒喝一声，朱雀圣火自灵杖喷涌而出，化作一道火墙，抵挡旱气：“妖孽休得猖狂，看我斩你！”
圣火至阳，与旱气相撞，半空之中发出滋滋声响，热浪翻滚，难分胜负。
旱魃冷哼一声，身形一闪，径直扑向祈雨坛，欲一掌毁坛，断绝祈雨之望。
陈学西身形骤起，白虎利刃寒光暴涨，纵身迎上，利刃直劈旱魃，白虎杀伐之气凛冽，直逼妖身。
旱魃见状，赤手相迎，掌心旱气凝聚，硬撼利刃，金铁交鸣之声响彻天际，陈学西被震得身形后退数步，掌心发麻，此妖力道之强，旱气之烈，远超预想。
content_en:
Cicuiyunling, the four gods were walking quickly along the west road. In less than half a day, the surrounding scenery suddenly changed.
First, the vegetation gradually became sparse, then the fine trees withered, and after a few miles, it turned out to be like a thousand miles of red ground. But I saw cracks in the fields, vertical and horizontal like spider webs, all the seedlings were withered, and no grass grew; the yellow sand was rolling in, covering the sky and the sun, the scorching sun was hanging in the sky, as fierce as fire, and the hot wind blew against the face, burning the skin. In the past, all the traffic on the streets was reduced to ruins. There was no smoke from cooking stoves and no barking of dogs. All that was left was desolation and lifelessness.
As we walked toward dusk, we suddenly saw hungry people crawling beside the road, with yellow faces and skinny muscles, and no clothes to cover their bodies. Some were lying on the dry soil, dying; some were supporting the elderly and the young, wandering beside the road, crying hoarsely, and it was unbearable to hear. Withered bones abandoned in the wilderness, and corpses of hungry people lying on the side of the road, it was a shocking scene of hell on earth.
Seeing this tragic situation, the four gods all showed compassion and solemn expressions.
Stopping in Ningyangbei, he lightly explored the aura of the green trees. He felt that the ground energy here was dry and lifeless. The scorching sun was unusually fierce. It was definitely not a natural drought. He said solemnly: "The land here is thousands of miles away, the people are in dire straits, the vitality is exhausted, and the fierce air is soaring into the sky. It must be the work of the drought demon, blocking the clouds and rain, causing the loss of life."
Wang Xuenan pinched his fingers to deduce, his face became darker, and he sighed: "This drought has lasted for three years. Not a single drop of rain has fallen. Rivers have stopped flowing, wells and springs have dried up. People have eaten all the roots and bark of trees. They have been displaced and there have been countless deaths and injuries. The Drought Demon is an ancient drought demon. It lives in a place where the red land is thousands of miles away. It is blocked by clouds and rain. It is difficult to shake its power with ordinary spiritual power."
Zhang Zhongdong was furious, holding the flaming staff in his hand, and said angrily: "The monster is causing trouble and harming the common people. We are destined to save the world, how can we just sit idly by and do nothing! We must kill this monster, bring down the rain, and save all people from the fire and water!"
Chen Xuexi's eyes were cold, scanning the deserted surroundings. The murderous aura of the white tiger around him was faint, and he nodded silently, already well prepared to defend against the enemy.
While he was talking, a group of hungry people saw the extraordinary aura of the four gods and the aura around them. They knew that they were enlightened masters. They struggled to get up, prostrated on the ground, kowtowed, and cried sadly: "Immortal, help me! Immortal, help me! There has been a drought here for three years. There is no harvest, and the people are dead and injured. We ask the immortal to be merciful and send down the rain to save us!"
The old man was holding a stick, the child was crying, his voice was bloody, he was kowtowing, his forehead was bleeding, it was terrible to see.
Ning Yangbei hurriedly stepped forward, helped everyone up, and said in a gentle voice: "Don't panic, fellow villagers. The four of us are the people who are traveling west to save the world. Seeing this disaster, we will do our best to help, kill the drought demon, clear the clouds and rain, and bring rain to the people. We will never let the people suffer like this again!"
When the people heard the words, they cried with joy, kowtowed again, and heard endless voices of gratitude.
Ning Yangbei immediately discussed with the three people: "The Drought Demon is entrenched here, blocking the clouds, and ordinary prayers for rain are useless. We need to build a prayer altar. The four of us will use the power of the four gods to induce the clouds in the sky and the earth, reaching up to the heaven, shaking the earth's veins, and then working together to kill the Drought Demon, so that rain can be given to the people."
Wang Xuenan nodded: "This method is feasible. You need to choose a high ground to build the altar. The four of us will guard the four sides. We will use the green wood to attract the earth's energy, the thick basalt to suppress the earth's veins, the red bird's sacred fire to communicate with the will of the sky, and the white tiger's golden edge to eliminate evil spirits. We work together to worship the sky, and then we can call the clouds to cause rain."
Immediately, the four gods found a high hill, ordered the people to retreat to a safe place, and began to build the altar.
Ning Yangbei activated the aura of green wood, turning dead wood into stone, gathering sand and soil to form the base of the altar. In an instant, a three-foot-high rain praying altar stood majestically. The altar is divided into four levels, corresponding to the four directions. No sacrifices are placed on the altar, no paper money is burned, only spiritual tablets are placed in the four directions, implying the principles of yin and yang of heaven and earth.
After the altar was completed, four people ascended the altar, each guarding one side.
Ningyang is located in the north and east, and the aura of green trees reaches the sky, awakening the remaining vitality of the earth;
Wang Xue lives in the south and in the north, the Xuanwu spiritual energy condenses, stabilizes the earth's veins, and dredges water vapor;
Zhang Zhong lives in the south, his flaming staff points to the sky, and the sacred fire of the red bird turns into rays of light, reaches the heaven, and inspires clouds and rain;
Chen Xuexi lives in the west. The white tiger sword stands in front of the altar, shrouded in a murderous atmosphere, on guard against the attack of the drought demon.
The four of them concentrated their efforts, made hand gestures, and silently recited the prayer formula in their mouths.Fang's divine power blended together and turned into a sky-reaching spiritual light, soaring straight into the sky.
The originally cloudless sky with the scorching sun gradually started to pick up the wind, and the clouds slowly gathered. The sky turned from red to dark, and dark clouds rolled in one after another. There was a faint sound of thunder, and signs of rain were already appearing.
When the people on the ground saw this vision, they all knelt down and kowtowed, waiting with bated breath, their eyes full of expectation.
At this moment, I suddenly heard a sharp and ear-piercing laughter, rolling from the nine heavens. The laughter was cold and dry. Wherever it passed, the clouds disappeared and the hot wind became stronger: "How dare you, young man, to trespass into my territory, try to pray for rain, and ruin my good deeds!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a gap opened in the dark clouds in the sky, and a red figure fell from the clouds and stood in the mid-air.
This demon's body is as red as fire, its hair is like flames, its face is as withered, its eyes are as red as fire, and it is covered in red scales. Its whole body exudes a monstrous hot air. Wherever it passes, the air is distorted and the vegetation is instantly scorched. It is the ancient drought demon!
The Han Demon stood on the clouds, looked down at the four gods on the altar, and shouted sternly: "I have practiced here for thousands of years, sucked up all the water vapor in this place, and formed a world of my own. How dare you, the mortal gods, to meddle in my own business and pray for rain to ruin my way? Retreat quickly, and you will not die, otherwise, I will completely turn this place into a dead place and let you disappear into ashes!"
Ning Yangbei stood on the altar, with a stern look on his face, and sternly rebuked: "Drought monster! You are entrenched here, blocking the clouds and rains, causing thousands of miles of red land, desolation of life, and tragic death of the people. The sin is so heinous that heaven and earth cannot tolerate it! We are ordered by God to save the world, and we will kill you today to clear the clouds and rain and save all people!"
Hearing the words, the Drought Demon looked up to the sky and laughed wildly. His laughter became even sharper. The red light around his body surged, and the hot air swept across all directions. The dark clouds that had just gathered were forced back several miles: "Only for you? How dare you speak such arrogant words! I am an ancient Drought Demon. Clouds and rain will avoid me when they see me, and rivers will wither when they meet me. How can you, your mortal power, be able to shake me!"
After saying this, Hanbao raised his hand and waved, and the red drought mist came overwhelmingly. Wherever it passed, the dead trees on the ground instantly turned into fly ash, and the cracks became more serious. The people screamed in shock, and the hot wind made it difficult for everyone to open their eyes.
Zhang Zhongdong shouted angrily, and the sacred fire of the Vermilion Bird spurted out from the spiritual staff, turning into a wall of fire to resist the drought: "Don't be so rampant, evildoer, watch me kill you!"
The holy fire reaches the sun, collides with the dry air, and makes a sizzling sound in the air. The heat wave rolls, and it is difficult to tell the winner.
Hanbao snorted coldly, dodged his body, and rushed straight towards the rain praying altar, intending to destroy the altar with one palm and cut off the hope of praying for rain.
Chen Xuexi suddenly rose up, the cold light of the white tiger's sharp blade surged, and he jumped forward to meet him. The sharp blade slashed directly at the demon demon, and the white tiger's killing aura was fierce, approaching the demon body.
Seeing this, the Han Demon greeted him with his bare hands. The drought energy in his palms condensed and struck the sharp blade hard. The sound of metal and iron clashing resounded throughout the sky. Chen Xuexi was so shocked that he took a few steps back and his palms became numb. The strength of this monster and the intensity of the drought energy were far beyond his expectation.
